title: Escape The Ghosts
description:
You are playing a simplified PAC-MAN game on an infinite 2D grid.

You start at position [0, 0].
You are given a target position target = [x_target, y_target].
There are multiple ghosts, where ghosts[i] = [xᵢ, yᵢ] represents the starting position of the i-th ghost.
Movement Rules

On each turn:

You and all ghosts can independently:
Move 1 unit in one of the four directions: up, down, left, right, or
Stay in the same position
All movements happen simultaneously
Escape Condition

You successfully escape if and only if:

You reach the target strictly before any ghost reaches you

Important:

If a ghost reaches the same position as you at the same time, you do not escape
This applies to any position, including the target
Task

Return true if it is possible to escape regardless of how the ghosts move, otherwise return false.

Examples

Example 1
Input: ghosts = [[1,0],[0,3]], target = [0,1]
Output: true
Explanation:
You reach the target in 1 move, while both ghosts need more time.

Example 2
Input: ghosts = [[1,0]], target = [2,0]
Output: false
Explanation:
The ghost can intercept or reach the target no later than you.

Example 3
Input: ghosts = [[2,0]], target = [1,0]
Output: false
Explanation:
Both you and the ghost can reach the target at the same time.

Constraints
1 ≤ ghosts.length ≤ 100
ghosts[i].length == 2
-10⁴ ≤ xᵢ, yᵢ ≤ 10⁴
Multiple ghosts may share the same position
target.length == 2
-10⁴ ≤ x_target, y_target ≤ 10⁴
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
